entities.summary: Georgios Tsalmpouris is a Greek professional basketball player for Panionios of the Greek Basketball League. Tsalmpouris is 7 ft 2 in (2.18 m) tall, weighs 240 pounds (110 kg), and plays at the power forward and center positions.
